title: fix: make paid_only a strict boolean in the model catalog
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
`paid_only` had three states: `true`, `false`, and missing. 43 registry entries never set it (Z-Image Turbo, FLUX.1 Schnell, GPT Image 1 Mini, …), so `/models` dropped the field and clients had to guess. Gen already treated missing as `false`.

- Makes `paidOnly: boolean` required on `ModelDefinition` and sets `paidOnly: false` on the 43 entries, so each new model must choose
- Makes `paid_only` required in the catalog schema, so every `/models` entry sends a boolean
- Drops the `?? false` fallbacks in gen's balance check and the community model builder; types `ModelInfo.paid_only` as `boolean` in the SDK
- Adds migration 0070: sets `paidOnly: false` on the 125 production community listings saved before paid-only support, then requires the field in the stored payload schema (no default). Runs on the production promotion deploy, before the workers; tested on staging (4 rows)
- Adds a `/models` test that every entry, including an old community payload without the key, has a boolean `paid_only`

No access changes: every model that was missing the flag was already treated as not paid-only. Partial-update inputs (community endpoint PATCH, pending changes) stay optional, since there a missing value means "unchanged".

- Model-news bot treats a missing `paid_only` in old snapshots as `false`, so the first report after deploy doesn't list 43 models as changed

gist.headline: No more mystery model flags
gist.blurb: Every model gets a definite answer to the paid-only question. The 43 models that left it blank were already treated as not paid-only; the catalog just makes that answer explicit.
gist.summary: Makes `paid_only` a required boolean in every `/models` entry, sets `false` on 43 registry models and 125 older community listings, and updates the SDK type without changing model access.
gist.impact: Clients can read `paid_only` as `true` or `false` for every model instead of guessing when the field is missing; community PATCH inputs remain optional so an omitted value still means unchanged.
